title: Reproducibility Metadata - Provenance Evaluation (PHEME + RumourEval / SemEval-2017 Task 8)

inputs.name: PHEME_veracity.tar.bz2 (in-repo archive)
inputs.source: PHEME dataset (GATE, Univ. of Sheffield); original download URL as recorded in provenance/data_discovery/PROVENANCE_DATASET_AUDIT.md (https://s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/downloads.gate.ac.uk/pheme/...)

inputs.name: semeval2017-task8-dataset.tar.bz2 (RumourEval train+dev)
inputs.source: SemEval-2017 Task 8 (RumourEval) - https://alt.qcri.org/semeval2017/task8/ ; mirrors recorded in provenance/data_discovery/PROVENANCE_DATASET_AUDIT.md

inputs.name: rumoureval2017-test.tar.bz2 (RumourEval test threads)
inputs.source: SemEval-2017 Task 8 (RumourEval) test threads; see above

inputs.name: subtaska.json (QCRI test labels)
inputs.source: QCRI SemEval-2017 Task 8 subtask-A test labels; provenance recorded in provenance/data_discovery/PROVENANCE_DATASET_AUDIT.md

procedure: Artifacts 01/07/09 are documentation derived from the machine outputs above.

determinism_check.method: two consecutive runs of pheme_provenance_pipeline.py; snapshot of emitted artifacts diffed
determinism_check.result: IDENTICAL for 02, 03(.json/.md), 04, 05, 06, 08. build_timestamp inside 08 (and in _data/_combined.json) differs by design and is excluded from comparison; all other bytes identical

frozen_formulas_used.R: exp(-lambda*(ref-t)), lambda=ln(2)/(7*86400s), ref=max created among case units
frozen_formulas_used.T: prior-outcome trust / user snapshot before each tweet over global chronological labelled asserting timeline; cold-start 0.5
frozen_formulas_used.L2_aware: per-origin max-Psi per value, then sum across origins; resolve if delta>=theta
frozen_formulas_used.L2_neutral: sum of all unit Psi per value; resolve if delta>=theta

notes: All outputs are machine-generated from the two scripts above; no LLM used anywhere in computation.
No writes were made to PHEME TEST, QACC, CALIBRATION or processed_results (frozen sub-corpus untouched).
SubtasksA test labels are stock QCRI outputs consumed as-is; no tuning or calibration was performed.
09's own SHA-256 cannot be self-referenced and is excluded from its outputs list.

ELECTION TARGETS vs ACTUAL BUILT: targets were P1=20, P2=20, P3=20, P4=20, P5=6; the dataset supplied eligible candidates for P2=20, P3=20, P4=20, but only P1=14 and P5=6 qualifying categories existed, so those slots stayed unfilled. This is a documented dataset-coverage limitation; it is reported as-is (election_targets vs elected_counts in 02 and 08), never silently inflated and never filled with fabricated cases.

Deterministic reruns: two consecutive runs produced byte-identical machine outputs (02/03.md+json/04/05/06/08), differing only by the build_timestamp field, and the analysis in report 07 was accepted as-is without re-tuning any parameter on PHEME TEST outcomes.
